nodes.title: Bora Line Rebula
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Bora Line Rebula comes from Kamen Drift in Vipava, Slovenia. The 2023 is Rebula, farmed with minimal sprays on small mixed plots where yield matters less than tension.

native yeast fermentation followed by quiet ageing; expect salt, pear skin, quince, redcurrant, sour cherry. Serve at 9-12C with tomato salads.

We bought it for the way it makes an unfamiliar place feel easy to pour without sanding off its edges.

nodes.title: Basalt Tide Arinto
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Basalt Tide Arinto comes from Pedra Nuvem in Pico, Azores. The 2023 is Arinto dos Acores, farmed with minimal sprays on small mixed plots where yield matters less than tension.

native yeast fermentation followed by quiet ageing; expect salt, smoke, lemon peel, cranberry, almond. Serve at 9-12C with hard cheese.

We bought it for the way it makes an unfamiliar place feel easy to pour without sanding off its edges.
